jp: <STBG 3,1><CHAR 1,0,1,0,0><CHAR 5,5,7,0,0><TALK 5><NAME 10><BGM 0,0,503><CV 5,25>You lot, may I have a moment?
<CHAR 1,0,1,0,0><TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,90>Dr. Andra.

<CHAR 5,0,7,0,2><TALK 5><NAME 10><CV 5,42>Do you know that something like
a labyrinth has been found in each corner
of the island?

I take it for a dungeon of metal
artefacts, as written in old books.

<CV 5,33>In its depths lies an item of immense
power, and whoever holds it is said
to become king.

<CHAR 1,0,1,2,1><TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,29>Amazing!
I want to investigate it too!

<CHAR 5,0,7,0,3><TALK 5><NAME 10><CV 5,1>As a researcher, it fascinates me!
The guild plans to send a large survey team.

<CHAR 5,0,7,0,2><TALK 5><NAME 10><CV 5,5>Of course, I want you to come along.
Will you lend your strength?
<CHAR 1,0,1,0,3><TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,11>Of course!

<ITEM PCOIN00199,1,1><CHAR 5,0,7,0,0><TALK 5><NAME 10><CV 5,19>Then first, secure the food we'll need
during the survey. Catch this fish
in great numbers.

Depending on this food supply
and your efforts...

<ITEM WD_LSWORD2215,1,1>I hear that those who once cleared
the dungeon will have their gear
given as a reward...

How about it?
Are you getting motivated?

<ITEM 0,1,0><CHAR 1,0,1,2,3><TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,4>Yes!
Leave it to us!
I can't wait for an unknown dungeon!

Precious discoveries and beautiful vistas
one after another — walking alone
would be a joy...!
<CHAR 5,0,7,0,0><TALK 5><NAME 10><CV 5,33>muscled limbs, a giant old man in a sword!

<CHAR 1,0,1,1,5><TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,94>...Huh? Not what I expected...
Ah, Doctor, my stomach feels...

<CHAR 5,0,7,0,3><TALK 5><NAME 10><CV 5,1>Moreover, unknown protozoa and
skewer traps — full of thrills!
<CHAR 1,0,1,1,7><TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,22>Ugh, now fever and dizziness too...

<CHAR 5,0,7,0,1><TALK 5><NAME 10><CV 5,18>An unprecedented discovery is just ahead!
Let's go!
<CHAR 5,6,7,0,0><CHAR 1,0,1,1,5><TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,35>Ah, he's not listening...
<CLS>
